text: My name is Alex and I am 28 years old.
I work as a software engineer at a tech startup in Lahore.
I graduated from GCU Lahore with a degree in Computer Science.
My favorite food is biryani, I could eat it every single day.
I am passionate about cricket and follow every match closely.
I am currently learning machine learning and deep learning.
My dream is to start my own AI startup someday.
I love reading books, especially self-help and technology books.
I have two siblings and we are very close as a family.
I enjoy hiking and outdoor activities on weekends.
I am an introvert and recharge by spending time alone.
My favorite programming languages are Python and JavaScript.
I drink tea three times a day, I cannot function without it.
I have traveled to Dubai, Turkey and Thailand.
I prefer remote work over going to an office.
My favorite season is winter, especially in Lahore.
I work out at the gym four times a week.
I am currently reading Atomic Habits by James Clear.
My biggest strength is problem solving and analytical thinking.
I am learning to play the guitar in my free time.
I believe consistency is the key to success in anything.
My favorite movie genre is thriller and science fiction.
I have a pet cat named Luna who I absolutely adore.
I am a morning person and wake up at 6am every day.
My mentor has been a huge influence on my career.
I love street food, especially gol gappay and bun kebab.
I am currently working on a personal project using FastAPI.
I value honesty and transparency in all my relationships.
I want to learn Spanish as my third language.
